buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Terms and conditions: 1. Manufacturing Capability: The Bidder Should be a strictly Original Equipment Manufacturer of required items (OEM) or Au thorized Dealer of OEM. Documentary proof to be submitted: Valid Factory license, OEM author ization and Affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper of ₹500 for production capacity in terms of number of quoted models being manufactured. 2. Past Performance: The bidder should have experience of successfully executing supply and installation of Kids/chil dren furniture in last three years ending on 31 March 2026 in any state or central Govt school/ college/institution. The bidder should provide technically clear completion certificate in approp riate format mentioning details of value of tender, value of work awarded, time of completion and result of performance etc. 3. Safety and Quality standards: The manufacturer must possess certificate of ISO-9001-2015 (systems and procedures) and ISO-14001-2015(Environment) OHSAS 18001-200 7 4. Test Report: The bidder shall submit product test reports issued by laboratories acc redited by NABL or by any BIS-recognized/empanelled laboratory unde r the BIS Laboratory Recognition Scheme (LRS), with testing conducted strictly as per the latest applicable Indian Standards. The test report m ust clearly indicate the product name, model, applicable standard, dat e of testing, validity, and conformity of all mandatory parameters as p er (IS 17633:2022). Reports from non-accredited or non-recognized lab oratories shall not be accepted. The Procuring Authority reserves the ri ght to verify the authenticity of submitted reports and to reject any rep ort found incomplete, invalid or inconsistent with the bid requirements. 5. Boucher/Catalogue: All bidders shall upload the catalogue/brochure of Modular toilets along with their bid, clearly indicating the technical specifications of the item offered. The submitted catalogue/brochure must correspond to the spe cifications in the bid and shall serve as the basis for technical evaluatio n. Any bid not accompanied by the requisite catalogue/brochure or con taining incomplete or ambiguous details may be rejected as technically non-responsive. After qualification in the technical evaluation, no chan ge, substitution or deviation in the specifications of the quoted items s hall be permitted. The successful bidder shall supply Modular toilets str ictly in accordance with specifications declared in the submitted catalo gue/brochure and accepted during technical evaluation. Any deviation shall be treated as a breach of the bid conditions and may attract appr opriate action as per the terms and conditions of the bid.

6. Financial Eligibility: The Annual Turnover of the bidder (Reseller / System Integrator / Non- OEM) during the last three financial years shall be not less than ₹9,00, 000 (Rupees Nine Lakh only), supported by audited financial statement s or CA-certified statements of accounts for the relevant years. In case the bidder is not the OEM, the OEM of the offered product shall have a Minimum Annual Turnover of ₹70,00,000 (Rupees Seventy Lakh only) d uring the last three financial years, supported by audited financial stat ements or CA-certified statements. Bidder shall submit CA-Certified fin ancial statement, including supporting schedules, conforming turnover and profitability, Income Tax Returns (ITR) for the last three fiscal year s and GSTR-3B filing for last three months must accompany the Bid. 7. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) and EMD exemption: An EMD amounting to ₹60,000 (Rupees Sixty Thousand Only) mus t be pledged in favor of the Chief Education Officer, Ganderbal , an d submitted along with the bid proposal. Failure to comply will lead to disqualification of the bidder. The bidder seeking EMD exemption must submit the valid supporting document for the relevant category as pe r GeM terms and condition with the bid. Under MSE category only man ufacturers of goods are eligible for exemption from EMD. 8. Declaration and Undertakings: The Bidder and OEM must submit an Undertaking and Affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper of ₹500, affirming that neither has been debarred, blacklisted and suspended by any Central/State Government Department, University, or PSU. 9. Delivery Condition: The Supply, installation, testing & commissioni ng of Modular Toilets should be made within the time period of 30 days from the date of issuance of contract.All the items shall be delivered a nd installed at the designated sites on FOR destination basis. In case of delay in Supply, installation, testing & commissioning, liquidated dama ge up to 1% per week, subject to maximum of 10% of order value will be imposed. 10. Service Support: The OEM/Bidder must give the certificate to provide immediate service s and technical support on site for the period of 3 years minimum. Bidd er are requested to provide escalation matrix for effective service supp ort. 11. Payment terms: Payment shall be made after successful delivery and installation, a cert ification to this effect must be furnished from the concerned HOIs. The Committee shall undertake the verification of procured materials and i nspect each delivered item to confirm its conformity with the agreed-u pon specifications, quality, quantity, and any other pertinent paramete rs outlined in the Bid terms and conditions before the payment. 12. The bidders should also abide by the rules laid down in the GFR-2017 and Procurement of Goods and Services strictly. 13. The quantity of the items in the bid is subject to availability of funds which can decrease or increase. 14. That bidder should strictly adhere to the rule viz a viz communication with the Department i.e. that they shall not make any telephonic Mess ages/calls and Personal approach to any govt. official of this office. Ho wever, in case of any query bidder must approach via GeM platform on ly.

15. This office reserves the right to terminate the contract of the firm in c ase any bidder/firm found interfering/exploiting with the purchasing pr ocess. 16. At any stage during the bidding process or after the issuance of the fo rmal supply order, if any document submitted by the participating firm is found to be forged, invalid, tampered with, misleading, or otherwise non-genuine, this office reserves the absolute right to cancel/terminate the bid, reject the offer, or annul the supply order without any liability whatsoever. The participating bidder shall mandatorily submit a bid-s pecific undertaking affirming the authenticity, genuineness, and vali dity of all documents submitted and confirming unconditional complian ce with this condition. 17. Each item shall conform to the approved specifications, quality stand ards detailed: I. General description: The toilet unit must be ready-made and factory-built. It must be delivered ready for installation at the select ed site. It must contain four separate toilet compartments, each wit h an Indian-style toilet pan, sanitary fittings, water supply, ventilatio n and waste-disposal arrangements. II. Frame and construction: The main frame must be made fro m good-quality mild steel sections. The frame, base, roof supports and internal partitions must be properly welded and assembled to make the unit strong and stable. The structure must be suitable for outdoor use. Doors must have suitable frames, hinges, locks and su pporting parts. The steel must be treated to prevent rust. III. Walls and roof: The side panels, doors and internal partitions must be made of good-quality fibre-reinforced plastic (FRP). The pa nels must be durable, water-resistant and easy to clean. The roof m ust be made of galvanised steel sheet with an insulated sandwich-p anel arrangement. EPS (expanded polystyrene) must be used for insulation. The roof must prevent water leakage and protect against weather. The colour will be chosen by the purchaser. IV. Sanitary fittings: Each compartment must have an Indian- style FRP toilet pan with footrests, a flush connected to the water su pply, a wash basin with tap and plumbing, a plastic soap dispenser, a mirror and other basic sanitary accessories. Doors must have suit able hinges, handles and locks. Proper ventilation must be provided. V. Water supply: The unit must have an overhead water tank of suitable capacity. The tank must be durable, double-layer HDPE. Wa ter must reach all toilet compartments and wash basins through suit able UPVC pipes. All necessary pipes, valves and fittings must be pr ovided, and the system must supply water to every compartment. VI. Waste and sewage disposal: The unit must have a system t o collect and dispose of sewage. A sludge tank of suitable capacity, made of durable FRP, must be provided. Suitable outlets, pipes and valves must be installed. The disposal system must connect with th e proposed leach pit or septic tank. Where required, twin leach pits must be provided, with suitable inspection and maintenance arrang ements. Leach pits must be built with concrete rings or masonry, pr oper covers and arrangements for waste absorption. Ventilation and

maintenance access must also be provided. VII. Electrical and ventilation arrangements: Suitable electrical provisions must be made. The unit must have enough ventilation op enings, including above the doors and at suitable places on the opp osite side. Electrical connections and fittings must meet the approv ed requirements. VIII. Floor and support: The floor must be made of suitable FRP m aterial. It must be durable and easy to clean. The unit must stand o n a suitable foundation, with steps or access arrangements for easy entry. The foundation must keep the structure stable. IX. Installation and commissioning: The supplier is responsible for delivering the complete unit, installing it at the selected site, co mpleting plumbing and sanitary connections, electrical connections, water supply and sewage arrangements, and testing the unit before handing it over. The unit must be fully working at handover. X. Quality, warranty and service: All materials must be good q uality and suitable for public use. The supplier must provide at least a one-year warranty and the necessary warranty documents and su pporting certificates. The supplier must provide a local service centr e or service support facility. GST proof and the applicable escalation matrix must also be submitted. XI. Site Visit and Technical Specification Confirmation: The p rospective bidders shall mandatorily visit the proposed site and disc uss/confirm the detailed technical specifications, site conditions and scope of work with the Chief education Officer Ganderbal, within 10 days from the date of publication of the bid. The bidder shall obtain a duly signed certificate/confirmation from the Chief Education Offic er Ganderbal, evidencing such site visit and technical discussion. Th e said certificate shall be submitted along with the bid documents. F ailure to submit the requisite proof/certificate shall render the bid liable for rejection. XII. Turnkey Responsibility: The successful bidder shall be respo nsible for complete execution of the work on turnkey basis. No addit ional payment shall ordinarily be admissible for items necessary for making the facility functional but inadvertently omitted from the bid der’s offer, where such items are reasonably incidental to the quote d scope. XIII. Transportation & Installation: Transportation, loading/unloading, shifting to site, erection, installation, tools, mach inery, labour and all incidental expenses shall be the responsibility of the successful bidder. XIV. Compulsory Dimension/requirements: The Modular Toilet Complex shall has to be installed at 03 defined / identified locations each having 4 compartments of size 915mm X 915mm x 1980mm and with Sludge tank with outlet facility throu gh butterfly valve and hose pipe. The Agency shall ensure that each toilet complex is properly fitted with separate septic tank of minimum size 10x5x7 feet (lengt h x breadth x depth) within the offered bid price and further ensu

re that the waste flow of the toilet complex is properly connected wi th septic tanks. The agency shall ensure that the Toilet Complex has proper electric fitting viz lights Exhaust fan, switches etc of standard make and ma nufacture. The agency shall ensure that the Modular Toilet Complex shall be pr operly fillet over civil foundation of minimum thickness 3.6 fee t (the visible thickness from ground should be 2 feet) with pr oper staircases. Besides each compartment shall have the door si ze of 585mmx1830mm (approx.).and each compartment is prop erly fitted with windows for lighting and ventilation. This shall be the job of the agency within the offered price. 18. Compliance Certificate: All the bidders must submit compliance certificate on bidder’s letter he ad regarding the compliance of bid document and bid ATCs. 19. The concerned DDO’s Zonal Education Officers and HOIs of the benefi ciary schools shall submit a completion/installation certificate to this of fice immediately upon execution. 20. The expenditure shall be met out of funds released under the UT cap ex Budget (Tribal) 2026-27. No expenditure shall exceed the approved outlay. 21. The Head of each institution shall ensure full operational functionality and proper utilization of the assets. 22. The Committee/Sub-Committee shall conduct post-installation inspect ion to verify compliance with the specifications, Bid Document, and Ad ditional Terms & Conditions. .
